scripts.validate: jq -e . .claude-plugin/marketplace.json >/dev/null && for f in plugins/*/.claude-plugin/plugin.json; do jq -e . "$f" >/dev/null; done && for f in plugins/*/hooks/hooks.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && jq -e . "$f" >/dev/null; done; echo 'OK: marketplace, plugin manifests, and hook files all valid'
scripts.smoke-service: rm -rf /tmp/test-svc && uv tool run --from copier copier copy ./templates/service-python /tmp/test-svc --defaults --trust --data project_name=test-svc --data module_name=test_svc --data description=test && cd /tmp/test-svc && devbox install && devbox run lint && devbox run typecheck
scripts.smoke-library: rm -rf /tmp/test-lib && uv tool run --from copier copier copy ./templates/library-python /tmp/test-lib --defaults --trust --data project_name=test-lib --data module_name=test_lib --data description=test && cd /tmp/test-lib && devbox install && devbox run lint && devbox run typecheck
scripts.smoke-gitops: rm -rf /tmp/test-gitops && uv tool run --from copier copier copy ./templates/gitops-app /tmp/test-gitops --defaults --trust --skip-tasks --data project_name=test-gitops --data app_name=test --data description=test && cd /tmp/test-gitops && uv run scripts/render.py --check
scripts.smoke: devbox run validate && devbox run shapes-check && devbox run test-detect && devbox run smoke-service && devbox run smoke-library && devbox run smoke-gitops
